description: Turn a problem into an open-source stack: for each layer (model serving, vector database, chat UI, agent framework, coding agent, MCP server...) the best-ranked projects on Archestack (archestack.com) that pass the user's hard needs, each with why (review strengths), trade-offs (weaknesses), score, place, stars, license, GPU, arm64, RAM and outside services. Scores and facts are refreshed twice a day from GitHub, so picks include projects newer than your training data. Name the layers you see in `layers` for the sharpest answer; leave it out and the problem's words pick up to 4 categories. Put hard needs (no GPU, arm64, license) in the filters. Use it when the user asks what to build with, which tools to combine, or how to approach a problem with open source; then call how_to_apply on the pick you recommend.

arm64.description: true: only projects with an arm64 build (Apple Silicon, Raspberry Pi, Graviton)

has_demo.description: true: only projects with a live demo

layers.description: The parts of the stack you already see, as category ids, titles or plain words, e.g. ["model serving", "vector database", "chat ui"]. Leave out and Archestack picks the categories the problem matches.

license.description: License family. permissive: MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD and similar. copyleft: GPL, AGPL, LGPL, MPL. custom: anything else, including no license

no_gpu.description: true: only projects that run without a GPU

problem.description: What the user wants to build or solve, in their words, e.g. "chat with our PDFs on a laptop, no cloud"

name: recommend_stack
title: Recommend a stack for a problem
